change: From rm-snapshot 1.0.3 (2026-11-19): layout only, owner decision by Gary Jensen. On screens 900 px and wider the 'Today's plan' and 'With lifetime income' cards now stack instead of sitting side by side (print already stacked them), and the breakdown lines are capped at 560 px wide so labels and amounts stay readable. No change to copy, branch selection, rounding rules or engine values. 1.0.3: fixes a display defect found in browser testing of the integrated funnel. A household with no Social Security or pension income showed '+$-0' on the 'Social Security & pensions' line of the breakdown. Amounts now never show a negative zero, and a zero line shows '$0' with no sign. No change to copy, branch selection, rounding rules or engine values. 1.0.1: the no-estimate message uses the live funnel's rate-data rule. Display layer for the redesigned Retirement Snapshot: formatter (branch selection and display rounding rules R1-R5), the approved copy library, a page fragment with styles scoped to .rms, and Print / Save as PDF (US Letter print layout, details expanded and the rest of the page hidden while printing). Never changes engine values. API: RMSnapshot.build(base, comparison, ctx) and RMSnapshot.render(container, base, comparison, ctx, opt). ctx: firstName, priorities (A.confidence, A.confidence2), state, totalAssets, bookingAllowed, two, inputs (the rm-box answers), optionA, prelim, mixEstimated, quoteDates, asOfYear.
verified: Run 2026-11-19: 50 engine-integrated households, 1,447 assertions recomputed from raw rm-box fields: 0 failures, including new assertion T2 (no negative-zero or signed-zero amounts in rendered text and HTML), which fails on 1.0.2 and passes on 1.0.3 and 1.0.4. Print: 165 checks across H1, H12, H20, E13 and Option A at 1280 px and 390 px: 0 failures. Browser parity: 49 of 49 households identical to the reference in Chromium.
